title: [HIGH] Persist ingestion and read catalog from the same store
body:
Audit ticket AUD-001 — 2026-10-13

Evidence: `src/lib/sources.ts:239-284` in working tree based on commit bba66f9. Some Phase 1 files are uncommitted.

Finding

Ingestion writes to a process-local map, while list/detail read seed files directly. All 18 records appear before ingestion; restarts and scale-out lose retry state.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Persist sources/chunks and ingestion state in Firestore; read APIs from that store; test partial ingestion, restart, retry and concurrent instances.
- [ ] Record actual verification and update this ticket before closing.

Approved project choices

Existing Phase 1 edits are confirmed. Public synthetic read-only UI and authenticated admin ingestion are approved. Dependency upgrades and Python installation are approved. GCP access may use gcloud/ADC; credentials must remain local and must never appear in tickets, logs, commits or container images.

This ticket tracks audit remediation; it does not authorize production cloud changes by itself.
